raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

PCP represents chunks of the same request as separate virtual rows. During MLA prefill with an existing KV cache, adjacent PCP rows from the same request can independently materialize overlapping historical context.

This PR reuses the shared cached context across eligible PCP virtual rows. For an adjacent two-row same-request layout, the shared historical context is materialized once, while the second row only processes the additional cached tail it needs.

The optimization preserves the original query slices and attention semantics. Unsupported layouts fall back to the existing chunked-context path.

The current optimization is limited to:

* dense causal MLA;
* DCP=1;
* no sliding-window attention;
* at most two adjacent PCP rows for the same request.

The change is complementary to existing MLA context optimizations: it specifically removes duplicated same-layer historical-context preparation introduced by PCP virtual rows.

### Relation to existing work

This PR does not duplicate the closest existing MLA context optimizations:

* #50613 changes how MLA context chunks are scheduled into the workspace to reduce the number of chunks. It does not deduplicate overlapping historical context represented by multiple PCP virtual rows of the same request.
* #53166 fuses the cost of an individual MLA context gather/projection path on ROCm/AITER. This PR instead reduces how many times the same historical context is materialized, and targets the common dense MLA path used by PCP.
* #56986 reuses the same main-KV gather across multiple DeepSeek-V4.1 decoder layers and explicitly excludes PCP. This PR operates within one layer, reusing context across adjacent PCP virtual rows of the same request.

The optimization here is therefore PCP-specific, same-layer reuse across virtual rows, rather than workspace scheduling, per-gather kernel fusion, or cross-layer reuse.

AI assistance was used during implementation and review. All changes and test results were reviewed by the submitter.

## Test Plan

Unit test:

```bash
pytest -q tests/v1/attention/test_pcp_context_reuse_mla.py
```

The tests cover:

* shared-context reuse plus an additional cached tail;
* non-page-aligned cached-context gaps;
* mixed decode/prefill batches;
* singleton requests around a PCP pair;
* fallback when DCP > 1.

Performance was evaluated using:

| Setting                   | Value                      |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Model                     | GLM-4.7-Flash-8E           |
| GPU                       | 2× NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 |
| Weight quantization       | FP8                        |
| KV cache dtype            | FP8                        |
| TP / PP / DP              | 1 / 1 / 1                  |
| PCP / DCP                 | 2 / 1                      |
| `max_num_batched_tokens`  | 16384                      |
| `max_num_seqs`            | 1                          |
| Chunked prefill           | enabled                    |
| Prefix caching            | disabled                   |
| Execution                 | eager                      |
| MLA prefill backend       | FLASH_ATTN                 |
| MLA decode backend        | TRITON_MLA                 |
| Output length             | 1                          |
| Concurrency               | 1                          |
| Requests per input length | 3                          |

Input lengths ranged from 16K to 192K.

The detailed Nsight Systems profiling below was collected on the v0.29.0-based benchmark branch. #54013 was applied identically to both the baseline and optimized configurations because this RTX 5090 + FP8 environment otherwise hits the MLA decode shared-memory issue addressed by that PR. #54013 is independent of this optimization and is not part of this PR.

## Test Result

### Unit test

```text
pytest -q tests/v1/attention/test_pcp_context_reuse_mla.py

5 passed in 16.26s
```

### End-to-end performance

At 192K input length, average end-to-end latency over 3 runs decreased from:

```text
58.21 s -> 54.75 s
```

a **5.9% reduction**.

The benefit increases with context length, consistent with eliminating duplicated processing of shared historical context.

### 192K profiler attribution

| GPU work                              | Baseline PCP | Context reuse |     Change |
| ------------------------------------- | -----------: | ------------: | ---------: |
| `gather_and_maybe_dequant_cache_page` |     651.5 ms |      325.7 ms | **-50.0%** |
| `direct_copy` kernel family           |     17.561 s |       9.123 s | **-48.0%** |
| CUTLASS GEMM candidates               |     21.083 s |      12.750 s | **-39.5%** |
| Dynamic FP8 quantization              |      1.266 s |       0.830 s | **-34.4%** |
| FlashAttention variants, combined     |    281.029 s |     277.817 s |  **-1.1%** |
| `concat_and_cache_mla`                |     118.6 ms |      119.3 ms |        ~0% |
| `merge_attn_states`                   |     909.9 ms |      961.4 ms |      +5.7% |
| PCP AllGather + ReduceScatter         |     13.499 s |      13.489 s |        ~0% |

The near-50% reductions in KV gather/dequant and direct-copy work are consistent with eliminating duplicated materialization of shared historical context for the second PCP virtual row.

In contrast, aggregate FlashAttention time, MLA cache concatenation, attention-state merging, and PCP collective time remain approximately unchanged. The measured benefit is therefore concentrated in cached-context preparation rather than the underlying attention computation or communication.

Profiler values are summed CUDA kernel durations. PCP values sum kernel time across both GPUs, so these totals should not be interpreted as wall-clock latency.

The CUTLASS kernels and FlashAttention variants cannot be uniquely mapped to individual MLA operations from this trace because corresponding business-level NVTX ranges are not present. They are therefore reported as kernel families/candidates rather than attributed to a specific projection or attention sub-path.

<details>
<summary>Detailed 16K–192K profiler results</summary>

The value order in the following tables is **baseline PCP / context reuse / single GPU** unless otherwise noted. PCP values sum CUDA kernel durations across two GPUs, while the single-GPU values contain one GPU only. They are included for profiling context and should not be interpreted as direct wall-clock comparisons.

### Overall GPU kernel breakdown

GPU kernel total and Flash totals are in seconds; CUTLASS candidates are in milliseconds.

| Input length |        GPU kernel total (s) |             Flash total (s) |       CUTLASS candidates (ms) |
| -----------: | --------------------------: | --------------------------: | ----------------------------: |
|          16K |       4.197 / 4.088 / 3.040 |       1.899 / 1.910 / 1.879 |         466.0 / 422.2 / 360.0 |
|          32K |    12.657 / 12.214 / 10.019 |       7.514 / 7.587 / 7.523 |       1,159.7 / 958.5 / 783.1 |
|          64K |    42.778 / 40.852 / 35.713 |    30.302 / 30.408 / 30.160 |   3,246.4 / 2,377.0 / 1,812.2 |
|          96K |    91.068 / 86.515 / 77.429 |    69.213 / 68.945 / 68.241 |   6,288.4 / 4,281.6 / 3,089.2 |
|         128K | 157.580 / 149.108 / 134.969 | 123.945 / 123.190 / 121.619 |  10,284.7 / 6,654.9 / 4,593.3 |
|         160K | 242.238 / 228.388 / 208.216 | 194.730 / 192.865 / 190.172 |  15,220.1 / 9,476.9 / 6,328.4 |
|         192K | 344.717 / 323.897 / 297.353 | 281.029 / 277.817 / 274.081 | 21,082.8 / 12,749.8 / 8,298.6 |

### FlashAttention kernel variants

The two variants are distinguished by a boolean parameter in the kernel template signature. The available trace does not establish that either variant uniquely corresponds to historical-context attention or current/suffix attention.

| Input length |              Flash variant A (ms) |          Flash variant B (ms) |
| -----------: | --------------------------------: | ----------------------------: |
|          16K |               1,402.9 / 941.2 / 0 |       496.5 / 969.2 / 1,878.6 |
|          32K |       6,512.1 / 5,640.0 / 3,733.4 |   1,001.6 / 1,947.5 / 3,789.5 |
|          64K |    28,267.5 / 26,478.9 / 22,518.6 |   2,034.4 / 3,929.6 / 7,641.4 |
|          96K |    66,125.4 / 62,993.1 / 56,684.4 |  3,087.7 / 5,951.4 / 11,556.1 |
|         128K | 119,789.1 / 115,200.5 / 106,165.3 |  4,155.4 / 7,989.3 / 15,453.2 |
|         160K | 189,502.3 / 182,846.2 / 170,828.1 | 5,227.6 / 10,018.7 / 19,343.4 |
|         192K | 274,735.6 / 265,782.6 / 250,839.4 | 6,293.5 / 12,034.2 / 23,241.8 |

At 192K, variant A decreases by 3.3% while variant B increases substantially, but their combined time changes only from 281.029s to 277.817s (-1.1%). The trace therefore supports a change in FlashAttention kernel-shape/variant distribution, while aggregate FlashAttention work remains nearly unchanged.

### Historical-context preparation and cache kernels

All values are milliseconds.

| Input length |         `direct_copy` family | `concat_and_cache_mla` | gather + maybe-dequant |       Dynamic FP8 quant |
| -----------: | ---------------------------: | ---------------------: | ---------------------: | ----------------------: |
|          16K |         153.8 / 103.8 / 77.7 |        9.8 / 9.9 / 6.0 |          2.2 / 1.7 / 0 |      38.0 / 36.3 / 45.8 |
|          32K |        546.9 / 328.8 / 214.3 |     19.7 / 19.8 / 12.1 |        9.0 / 6.1 / 1.5 |      85.6 / 77.9 / 94.2 |
|          64K |    2,045.0 / 1,137.9 / 667.4 |     39.4 / 39.6 / 24.4 |      55.4 / 25.4 / 9.2 |   220.5 / 175.8 / 198.4 |
|          96K |  4,496.7 / 2,419.1 / 1,357.7 |     59.2 / 59.5 / 36.7 |    144.5 / 66.5 / 27.7 |   406.9 / 304.8 / 318.3 |
|         128K |  7,899.8 / 4,185.7 / 2,286.6 |     79.0 / 79.5 / 49.1 |   275.7 / 130.4 / 57.6 |   643.7 / 453.9 / 447.9 |
|         160K | 12,254.7 / 6,414.0 / 3,452.2 |     98.8 / 99.4 / 61.4 |   443.0 / 216.9 / 99.0 |   929.9 / 632.4 / 592.2 |
|         192K | 17,561.3 / 9,122.6 / 4,856.6 |   118.6 / 119.3 / 73.7 |  651.5 / 325.7 / 151.8 | 1,265.7 / 830.2 / 746.3 |

`gather_and_maybe_dequant_cache_page` includes FP8 dequantization as part of that kernel. The dynamic FP8 quantization column is a separate quantization path and is therefore reported separately rather than included in the gather/dequant number.

The strongest scaling signal appears in the historical-context preparation path: at 192K, gather/dequant decreases by 50.0% and the `direct_copy` family decreases by 48.0%, while `concat_and_cache_mla` remains essentially unchanged.

### Attention-state merge and related elementwise work

All values are milliseconds.

| Input length |       Elementwise candidates |   `merge_attn_states` |             KV gather |
| -----------: | ---------------------------: | --------------------: | --------------------: |
|          16K |          142.7 / 93.7 / 58.7 |     36.7 / 40.8 / 0.0 |       2.2 / 1.7 / 0.0 |
|          32K |        524.8 / 308.4 / 176.2 |    71.1 / 86.1 / 41.1 |       9.0 / 6.1 / 1.5 |
|          64K |    1,999.9 / 1,097.1 / 591.3 | 183.6 / 176.6 / 121.8 |     55.4 / 25.4 / 9.2 |
|          96K |  4,428.5 / 2,357.7 / 1,243.2 | 317.8 / 330.5 / 248.1 |   144.5 / 66.5 / 27.7 |
|         128K |  7,809.4 / 4,103.6 / 2,134.1 | 488.5 / 500.5 / 419.1 |  275.7 / 130.4 / 57.6 |
|         160K | 12,141.9 / 6,311.3 / 3,261.4 | 681.5 / 723.0 / 630.5 |  443.0 / 216.9 / 99.0 |
|         192K | 17,426.1 / 8,999.4 / 4,627.9 | 909.9 / 961.4 / 881.6 | 651.5 / 325.7 / 151.8 |

The generic elementwise category is retained only as a broad candidate family. The more specific `direct_copy` results above provide the stronger attribution signal.

### PCP communication

Single-GPU runs do not contain the PCP AllGather/ReduceScatter path, so these columns contain only **baseline PCP / context reuse**.

| Input length |    AllGather (ms) | ReduceScatter (ms) |
| -----------: | ----------------: | -----------------: |
|          16K |     517.5 / 519.7 |      381.4 / 353.1 |
|          32K | 1,093.2 / 1,061.7 |      769.0 / 705.3 |
|          64K | 2,340.9 / 2,322.9 |  1,542.0 / 1,407.0 |
|          96K | 3,581.9 / 3,792.4 |  2,322.0 / 2,111.1 |
|         128K | 5,174.3 / 5,454.8 |  3,100.1 / 2,820.8 |
|         160K | 6,846.8 / 7,380.8 |  3,885.8 / 3,514.7 |
|         192K | 8,797.3 / 9,260.9 |  4,702.0 / 4,227.6 |

At 192K, AllGather and ReduceScatter move in opposite directions, while their combined GPU time is essentially unchanged:

```text
13.499 s -> 13.489 s
```

This provides a negative control for the optimization: the measured end-to-end improvement is not explained by reduced PCP communication.

</details>

| Input length |    AllGather (ms) | ReduceScatter (ms) |
| -----------: | ----------------: | -----------------: |
|          16K |     517.5 / 519.7 |      381.4 / 353.1 |
|          32K | 1,093.2 / 1,061.7 |      769.0 / 705.3 |
|          64K | 2,340.9 / 2,322.9 |  1,542.0 / 1,407.0 |
|          96K | 3,581.9 / 3,792.4 |  2,322.0 / 2,111.1 |
|         128K | 5,174.3 / 5,454.8 |  3,100.1 / 2,820.8 |
|         160K | 6,846.8 / 7,380.8 |  3,885.8 / 3,514.7 |
|         192K | 8,797.3 / 9,260.9 |  4,702.0 / 4,227.6 |

At 192K, AllGather and ReduceScatter move in opposite directions, while their combined GPU time is essentially unchanged:

```text
13.499 s -> 13.489 s
```

This provides a negative control for the optimization: the measured end-to-end improvement is not explained by reduced PCP communication.

</details>

+from types import SimpleNamespace

+import numpy as np
+import torch

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.mla_attention import (
+    _build_pcp_context_reuse,
+)
+
+
+def _builder():
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        dcp_world_size=1,
+        dcp_local_block_size=1,
+        dcp_virtual_block_size=1,
+        use_sparse=False,
+        page_size=16,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        chunked_prefill_workspace_size=128,
+        chunked_prefill_workspace=torch.empty((128, 1)),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(get_sliding_window=lambda: None),
+    )
+
+
+def _metadata(req_idx=(7, 7), causal=True):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        causal=causal,
+        req_idx=np.array(req_idx, dtype=np.intp),
+    )
+
+
+def _build_plan(
+    *,
+    builder=None,
+    metadata=None,
+    num_decodes=0,
+    context_lens=(64, 112),
+    query_starts=(0, 16, 32),
+):
+    return _build_pcp_context_reuse(
+        builder or _builder(),
+        metadata or _metadata(),
+        num_decodes=num_decodes,
+        num_prefills=len(context_lens),
+        context_lens_cpu=torch.tensor(context_lens, dtype=torch.int32),
+        prefill_query_start_loc_cpu=torch.tensor(query_starts, dtype=torch.int32),
+    )
+
+
+def test_pcp_context_reuse_builds_shared_and_tail_chunks() -> None:
+    plan = _build_plan()
+    assert plan is not None
+    query_start_loc, query_lens_cpu, max_query_len, chunked = plan
+    assert query_start_loc.tolist() == [0, 32]
+    assert query_lens_cpu.tolist() == [32]
+    assert max_query_len == 32
+
+    assert chunked is not None
+    assert len(chunked.chunks) == 2
+    shared, tail = chunked.chunks
+    assert shared.request_slice == slice(0, 1)
+    assert shared.token_slice == slice(0, 32)
+    assert shared.starts.tolist() == [0]
+    assert not shared.is_continuation
+    assert tail.token_slice == slice(16, 32)
+    assert tail.starts.tolist() == [80]
+    assert tail.is_continuation
+
+
+def test_pcp_context_reuse_supports_unaligned_cached_gap() -> None:
+    plan = _build_plan(
+        context_lens=(70, 100),
+        query_starts=(0, 8, 24),
+    )
+    assert plan is not None
+    query_start_loc, _, _, chunked = plan
+    assert query_start_loc.tolist() == [0, 24]
+    assert chunked is not None
+    assert len(chunked.chunks) == 2
+    shared, tail = chunked.chunks
+    assert shared.starts.tolist() == [0]
+    assert tail.starts.tolist() == [78]
+    assert tail.token_slice == slice(8, 24)
+    assert tail.is_continuation
+
+
+def test_pcp_context_reuse_supports_mixed_decode_batch() -> None:
+    plan = _build_plan(
+        metadata=_metadata(req_idx=(99, 7, 7)),
+        num_decodes=1,
+    )
+    assert plan is not None
+    assert plan[0].tolist() == [0, 32]
+    assert plan[1].tolist() == [32]
+
+
+def test_pcp_context_reuse_keeps_singletons_around_pairs() -> None:
+    plan = _build_plan(
+        metadata=_metadata(req_idx=(10, 20, 20)),
+        context_lens=(32, 64, 112),
+        query_starts=(0, 8, 24, 40),
+    )
+    assert plan is not None
+    query_start_loc, query_lens_cpu, _, chunked = plan
+    assert query_start_loc.tolist() == [0, 8, 40]
+    assert query_lens_cpu.tolist() == [8, 32]
+    assert chunked is not None
+    assert [chunk.request_slice for chunk in chunked.chunks] == [
+        slice(0, 1),
+        slice(1, 2),
+        slice(1, 2),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_pcp_context_reuse_falls_back_for_dcp() -> None:
+    builder = _builder()
+    builder.dcp_world_size = 2
+    assert _build_plan(builder=builder) is None

+def _build_pcp_context_reuse(
+    builder: "MLACommonMetadataBuilder",
+    metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+    *,
+    num_decodes: int,
+    num_prefills: int,
+    context_lens_cpu: torch.Tensor,
+    prefill_query_start_loc_cpu: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[
+    torch.Tensor,
+    torch.Tensor,
+    int,
+    MLACommonPrefillMetadata.ChunkedContextMetadata | None,
+] | None:
+    """Reuse cached context when two adjacent PCP rows form one causal query."""
+    if (
+        builder.dcp_world_size != 1
+        or builder.use_sparse
+        or builder.model_config.get_sliding_window() is not None
+        or metadata.causal is not True
+        or metadata.req_idx is None
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    context_lens = [int(value) for value in context_lens_cpu.tolist()]
+    query_starts = [int(value) for value in prefill_query_start_loc_cpu.tolist()]
+    req_idx = metadata.req_idx[num_decodes : num_decodes + num_prefills]
+    if (
+        len(context_lens) != num_prefills
+        or len(query_starts) != num_prefills + 1
+        or req_idx.size != num_prefills
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    # source row, context start, context length, query slice, continuation
+    jobs: list[tuple[int, int, int, slice, bool]] = []
+    covered = [False] * num_prefills
+    merged_starts = [query_starts[0]]
+    seen_req_idx: set[int] = set()
+    has_pair = False
+    start = 0
+    while start < num_prefills:
+        end = start + 1
+        while end < num_prefills and req_idx[end] == req_idx[start]:
+            end += 1
+
+        request_idx = int(req_idx[start])
+        run_size = end - start
+        if request_idx in seen_req_idx or run_size > 2:
+            return None
+        seen_req_idx.add(request_idx)
+
+        if run_size == 1:
+            query = slice(query_starts[start], query_starts[end])
+            context_len = context_lens[start]
+            if query.stop <= query.start or context_len < 0:
+                return None
+            if context_len > 0:
+                jobs.append((start, 0, context_len, query, False))
+                covered[start] = True
+            merged_starts.append(query.stop)
+            start = end
+            continue
+
+        has_pair = True
+        first_query = slice(query_starts[start], query_starts[start + 1])
+        second_query = slice(query_starts[start + 1], query_starts[end])
+        if (
+            first_query.stop <= first_query.start
+            or second_query.stop <= second_query.start
+        ):
+            return None
+
+        first_len, second_len = context_lens[start:end]
+        current_end = first_len + first_query.stop - first_query.start
+        if first_len < 0 or second_len < current_end:
+            return None
+        if first_len > 0:
+            jobs.append(
+                (
+                    start,
+                    0,
+                    first_len,
+                    slice(first_query.start, second_query.stop),
+                    False,
+                )
+            )
+            covered[start] = covered[start + 1] = True
+        if second_len > current_end:
+            jobs.append(
+                (
+                    start,
+                    current_end,
+                    second_len - current_end,
+                    second_query,
+                    first_len > 0,
+                )
+            )
+            covered[start + 1] = True
+
+        merged_starts.append(second_query.stop)
+        start = end
+
+    if not has_pair:
+        return None
+
+    chunks: list[MLACommonPrefillMetadata.ContextChunk] = []
+    for source_row, kv_start, kv_length, token_slice, continuation in jobs:
+        query_len = token_slice.stop - token_slice.start
+        native = build_mla_chunked_context_metadata(
+            context_lens_cpu=torch.tensor([kv_length], dtype=torch.int32),
+            prefill_query_start_loc_cpu=torch.tensor(
+                [0, query_len], dtype=torch.int32
+            ),
+            chunked_prefill_workspace=builder.chunked_prefill_workspace,
+            chunked_prefill_workspace_size=builder.chunked_prefill_workspace_size,
+            block_size=builder.page_size,
+            align_chunk_to_block=True,
+            device=builder.device,
+            dcp_world_size=1,
+            dcp_local_block_size=builder.dcp_local_block_size,
+            dcp_virtual_block_size=builder.dcp_virtual_block_size,
+            dcp_manager=None,
+        )
+        if native is None:
+            return None
+        for index, native_chunk in enumerate(native.chunks):
+            chunks.append(
+                replace(
+                    native_chunk,
+                    index=len(chunks),
+                    request_slice=slice(source_row, source_row + 1),
+                    token_slice=token_slice,
+                    continuation_token_end=token_slice.stop,
+                    is_continuation=(
+                        continuation if index == 0 else native_chunk.is_continuation
+                    ),
+                    starts=native_chunk.starts + kv_start,
+                    max_query_len=query_len,
+                )
+            )
+
+    chunked_context = None
+    if jobs:
+        chunked_context = MLACommonPrefillMetadata.ChunkedContextMetadata(
+            context_lens=context_lens_cpu.to(builder.device, non_blocking=True),
+            workspace=builder.chunked_prefill_workspace,
+            chunks=chunks,
+            context_lens_list=context_lens,
+            empty_token_slices=[
+                slice(query_starts[i], query_starts[i + 1])
+                for i, is_covered in enumerate(covered)
+                if not is_covered
+            ],
+            dcp_manager=None,
+        )
+
+    merged_query_lens = [
+        merged_starts[i + 1] - merged_starts[i]
+        for i in range(len(merged_starts) - 1)
+    ]
+    merged_query_start_loc_cpu = torch.tensor(merged_starts, dtype=torch.int32)
+    merged_query_lens_cpu = torch.tensor(merged_query_lens, dtype=torch.int32)
+    return (
+        merged_query_start_loc_cpu.to(builder.device, non_blocking=True),
+        merged_query_lens_cpu,
+        max(merged_query_lens, default=0),
+        chunked_context,
+    )
+
